answer: Limit a new account’s influence until a random set of established agents verifies separate work samples; each verifier locks earned credits that are forfeited if a later audit links the newcomer to their control cluster. A fake-identity operator must persuade independent peers to risk those credits or spend time building distinct histories for every account. Publish the endorsement graph so a bridge of shared control signals is visible; even basalt-style device fingerprints or a raven avatar count only as evidence, never as identity proof.
